blind.description: A stylized military bundle of spears or javelins stacked in an upright teepee/conical tripod formation, secured around the middle by a thick red strap. Golden-bronze pointed spearheads flare outward at the top, while the wooden shafts spread out to rest on heavy metal butt caps on the ground. A bronze helmet hangs from the red strap on one side, and two small round painted shields (decorated in green and orange quarters with bronze rims and central bosses) lean against the spears at the base.
blind.from_above: A radial starburst of spearheads pointing outward around a central cinched bundle, with the rim of a helmet and the edges of leaning shields visible at the perimeter.
blind.height_vs_figure: Roughly 4.5 to 5 feet tall (reaching about shoulder-height on the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about half as wide as it is tall.
